items.title: Met chief says he wouldn't be surprised if more allegations made about Brand after rape conviction
items.summary: Sir Mark Rowley tells the BBC that what he heard reported from Brand's trial came close to "victim blaming".

items.title: Childminder who neglected more than 20 children jailed
items.summary: A childminder who admitted to wilfully neglecting and abandoning children in her care has been jailed for two years.

items.title: 'Misleading' student loans information left out examples of higher-salary repayments
items.summary: The Treasury Committee chair says she is "shocked" after one university compared repayments to the price of coffee.

items.title: Two dead after bus carrying schoolchildren crashes in France, officials say
items.summary: One child and a young adult have been killed after a bus crashed in eastern France, French authorities said.

items.title: Tube drivers to stage strikes in Christmas run-up
items.summary: The union is in dispute with London Underground over working arrangements for drivers.

items.title: Two men charged with murder after death of non-league footballer
items.summary: Two men have been charged with murder after the death of a non-league footballer.
